paper.working_title: SagarVaani: Fail-Closed Evidence Gating and Bounded Recovery for Marine and Coastal Advisories
paper.framing: design + honest status (architecture is a design/specification contribution; reviewed repo is a partially-implemented prototype)

honesty_rules: No measured number enters the paper unless it has an experimental_log.md entry.
The three-valued policy, closed-list recovery, fingerprinting, guarded state machine are presented as DESIGN, not as implemented/measured.
No claim that SagarVaani outperforms any cited work (no head-to-head experiment exists).
Prior-art patents and arXiv preprints are NOT labelled Crossref-verified; cite patents only if venue allows and in a separate list.
The only real empirical results are the 62-passing pytest suite and code-verifiable fail-closed-on-missing-data behaviour.

introduction_strategy.hook: In marine safety, absence of a warning is itself a message; a generative advisory that stays fluent when evidence is missing converts a data failure into an apparent assurance of safety.
introduction_strategy.problem: Score/consensus-based agent controls measure agreement, not whether a mandatory safety check could be evaluated at all.
introduction_strategy.gap: No release primitive for 'input unavailable -> withhold' that is distinct from pass/block and independent of the model.
introduction_strategy.approach_one_liner: A deterministic, three-valued, fail-closed release interlock with bounded closed-list recovery and auditable abstention, layered over a multi-agent marine-advisory prototype.
introduction_strategy.honesty_sentence: We present the interlock as a design and report the status of a partial prototype; we do not claim measured safety improvements.
numbered_contributions: A three-valued (PASS/BLOCK/NOT_EVALUABLE) release policy with a fixed, model-independent derivation where NOT_EVALUABLE encodes input unavailability and prevents release.
A deterministic release interlock decoupled from the agents/LLM selector (selector proposes recovery, never decides).
Bounded closed-list recovery with gap fingerprinting for no-progress termination (finite budget + deadline), ending in auditable abstention rather than a synthesised advisory.
A guarded state machine + audit store design (checksummed artefacts), and an honest implementation-status account validated by a 62-test prototype that already enforces fail-closed-on-missing-data.
